_comment: The rules that govern main, as code. This file is the source of truth:
it is applied with `node scripts/protect-main.mjs apply` and CI's
`protection` job fails when the live ruleset has drifted from it, so a
required check cannot vanish by a click. COLLABORATION.md says what the
rules mean; the reasons, in one line each:
- a change reaches main only by pull request, so that lanes never share
a working tree or an index, which is where every accident of
- the three CI jobs are required, so that a green PR is a PR that passed
what main is held to, on both platforms and with the conformance suite;
- no approval is required, so that a green, in-scope PR is its author's
to merge and a lane never waits on a person — review is a comment,
- strict is off, so that a PR green against a main that moved is still
green, and parallel lanes do not serialise on rebasing;
- nobody is exempt, the coordinator included.
name: main
